review_set.duplicate_bytes_basis: sum of verified file lengths for inventory paths classified duplicate; not an approved deletion estimate

planning.estimated_full_market_required_bytes_bas: active_universe_count_times_observed_p99_bytes; conservative upper planning estimate, not catalog required-set truth
planning.expected_annual_growth_basis: active universe times observed manifest-verified candidate mean
planning.temporary_peak_basis: configured max attachment bytes times download concurrency; excludes unknown provider overhead
planning.backup_headroom_basis: backup free bytes minus conservative full-market estimate
